hints.title: Capacity Search Range
hints.text: The minimum possible load is one and the maximum is the greatest individual quantity.

hints.title: Store Requirement Function
hints.text: For a candidate capacity x, calculate how many stores are required by rounding up each quotient.

hints.title: Feasibility Adjustment
hints.text: Adjust search bounds based on whether the required stores count does not exceed available stores n.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M * log(MAX_QTY)) binary search on distribution capacity
complexity.notes: Monotonic feasibility allows binary searching the optimal load capacity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy allocation with a priority queue takes O(N log M) which is too slow when N is large.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search over values evaluates feasibility in O(M) per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should use ceil division (q + x - 1) // x to count required stores.
